item.title: Listener Supported. Life Changing.​
item.description: When MyBridge radio was birthed over 20 years ago, we made the strategic decision to be commercial free, listener supported! That decision has allowed us to program with only you in mind!

item.title: The STINT Discipleship Weekend Discount
item.description: There are special early-bird discounts available throughout November. Plus, MyBridge listeners can save even more—25% off—by using the discount code MYBRIDGE at checkout.

item.title: Hope for the Holidays
item.description: The holidays don’t always look the way we expected. For many, this season can bring painful reminders of loss, change, or disappointment.

item.title: Repeat the sounding J.O.Y.
item.description: J -- Remember that Jesus is the reason for the season! ​ O -- Reflect to Others expressions of His redeeming love!​ Y -- Reserve for Yourself time for meaningful reflection! ​

item.title: Drive-Thru Day
item.description: Drive-Thru Day is Friday, December 12! Print your note here and get ready to spread some JOY!

item.title: Year-End Gift
item.description: The remaining need for the 2026 vision is $218,755. Your generosity today helps MyBridge continue sharing the hope of Jesus across Nebraska and beyond.

item.title: Day Sponsors
item.description: Choose a day to celebrate or remember those special people or events in your life with a personalized message played every hour. A day sponsorship is $500 for a half-day or $1,000 for a full day. Check for available dates.

item.title: Experiencing God
item.description: God is quietly and powerfully at work around us, inviting us to know Him more deeply, hear His voice more clearly, and join Him in what He is already doing. Many of us simply need help learning how to recognize His leading and respond with faith.

item.title: Hope In Your Home
item.description: What fills your space shapes your heart. Discover more ways to bring MyBridge Radio into your home with a smart speaker. 👉 Important with Alexa+: Because of recent updates, make sure you include the word “skill” when asking Alexa to play MyBridge Radio. This helps Alexa understand exactly what you want.
